Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class ChargingStartedHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.ChargingStartedHistoryLog
public class ChargingStartedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
Battery snapshot written when charging starts, on both the Mobi and the t:slim X2. Every CurrentBatteryV2Response chargingStatus 0 to 1 transition seen in the maintainer's and a tester's Mobi captures (9 of 9) has one within seconds, and every record matches such a transition. On the t:slim X2 it usually follows a UsbConnectedHistoryLog by a few seconds. The class name is provisional: opcode 34 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi app's history log list. ChargingStoppedHistoryLog has the same layout. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
